Interface WebTestClient

public interface WebTestClient
Client for testing web servers that uses WebClient internally to perform requests while also providing a fluent API to verify responses. This client can connect to any server over HTTP, or to a WebFlux application with a mock request and response.

使用其中一个 `bindToXxx` 方法创建实例。例如：

  • bindToController(Object...)
  • bindToRouterFunction(RouterFunction)
  • bindToApplicationContext(ApplicationContext)
  • bindToServer()
  • ...
Since:
5.0
Author:
Rossen Stoyanchev，Brian Clozel，Sam Brannen，Michał Rowicki

  • 字段详情

    • WEBTESTCLIENT_REQUEST_ID

      static final String WEBTESTCLIENT_REQUEST_ID
      用于通过 `WebTestClient` 执行的每个请求分配唯一 ID 的请求头名称。这对于在请求处理的所有阶段（例如，来自服务器端组件）在该 ID 下存储上下文信息，并在稍后 `ExchangeResult` 可用时查找该信息非常有用。
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • bindToApplicationContext

      static WebTestClient.MockServerSpec<?> bindToApplicationContext(ApplicationContext applicationContext)
      Use this option to set up a server from the Spring configuration of your application, or some subset of it. Internally the provided configuration is passed to WebHttpHandlerBuilder to set up the request processing chain. The resulting WebFlux application will be tested without an HTTP server using a mock request and response.

      考虑使用 TestContext 框架和 @ContextConfiguration，以便高效地将 Spring 配置加载并注入到测试类中。

      Parameters:
      applicationContext - Spring 上下文
      Returns:
      链式 API 用于自定义服务器和客户端配置；使用 WebTestClient.MockServerSpec.configureClient() 切换到客户端配置。
